hooks.command: sh -c 'd=${PWD:-.}; while :; do if [ -f "$d/.claude/hooks/ctx_hook_dispatch.sh" ]; then exec sh "$d/.claude/hooks/ctx_hook_dispatch.sh" ctx_post_tool_use.py; fi; [ "$d" = "/" ] && exit 0; d=$(dirname "$d"); done'

sh -c 'd=${PWD:-.}; while :; do if [ -f "$d/.claude/hooks/ctx_hook_dispatch.sh" ]; then exec sh "$d/.claude/hooks/ctx_hook_dispatch.sh" ctx_session_start.py; fi; [ "$d" = "/" ] && exit 0; d=$(dirname "$d"); done'

sh -c 'd=${PWD:-.}; while :; do if [ -f "$d/.claude/hooks/ctx_hook_dispatch.sh" ]; then exec sh "$d/.claude/hooks/ctx_hook_dispatch.sh" ctx_stop.py; fi; [ "$d" = "/" ] && exit 0; d=$(dirname "$d"); done'

sh -c 'd=${PWD:-.}; while :; do if [ -f "$d/.claude/hooks/ctx_hook_dispatch.sh" ]; then exec sh "$d/.claude/hooks/ctx_hook_dispatch.sh" ctx_user_prompt_submit.py; fi; [ "$d" = "/" ] && exit 0; d=$(dirname "$d"); done'
